<mxfile host="Electron" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="pSbjnUPb4xCAMD1tPQvD"> <mxGraphModel dx="1366" dy="889" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
left to right direction
skinparam packageStyle rectangle

actor \"Student\" as student
actor \"Lecturer / TA\" as lecturer

rectangle \"Hệ thống Quản lý Tiến độ\" {
 ' Must-have Use Cases
 usecase \"Xem tiến độ nhóm\" as UC1
 usecase \"Xem trạng thái nộp\" as UC1_1
 usecase \"Nhận nhắc nhở\n(Cá nhân / Nhóm)\" as UC2
 usecase \"Gửi yêu cầu hỗ trợ\" as UC3
 usecase \"Đăng ký hỗ trợ\n(Phản hồi yêu cầu)\" as UC4
 
 ' Nice to have Use Cases
 usecase \"Theo dõi tiến độ lớp\" as UC5
 usecase \"Cấu hình ngưỡng nhắc\n& mức hiển thị\" as UC6
}

' Relationships for Student
student --> UC1
UC1 ..> UC1_1 : <<include>>
student --> UC2
student --> UC4

' Extend relationship
UC3 .up.> UC1 : <<extend>>
student --> UC3

' Relationships for Lecturer/TA
lecturer --> UC5
lecturer --> UC6

@enduml",
 "config": null
